No scripts or commands are present in this file—only declarative packaging metadata.

While the source is a prebuilt binary (which inherently limits auditability), the file itself contains no malicious indicators. The use of a pinned release tag (v0.1.1) and a valid checksum means the source is reproducible and verifiable. This aligns with standard AUR practices for `-bin` packages. There is no evidence of supply chain tampering, data exfiltration, or remote code execution in the provided metadata.
